ideas.title: Uncovering the Minnesota Day-Care Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the multimillion-dollar day-care fraud scheme in Minnesota, including the entities involved and the impact on the state's budget.
questions: What is the extent of the day-care fraud scheme in Minnesota?
How much money has been lost due to the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. It is essential to investigate the entities involved and the impact on the state's budget.
